title: Personal Training Packages: the trainer-reassignment free-use allowance
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the basis for the trainer-reassignment free-use allowance on a package.

## Rule
A member may request that the trainer assigned to their package be reassigned. The first reassignments on a package, up to the tier's own free-use allowance, are free.

~~each further reassignment is charged the tier's own flat reassignment fee~~ This clause is no longer in force for what is charged once the free-use allowance is exhausted; the current basis for a chargeable reassignment fee is stated in the corporate-wellness-discount-on-a-reassignment-fee document for this product.

## Points of judgement
The free-use allowance is counted per package: the running count of reassignments already logged against that same package decides whether the next one still falls within the tier's own free allowance. A reassignment that is the tier's allowance-th or an earlier one on that package is free; a reassignment beyond that count is chargeable rather than free.

superseded_clauses: each further reassignment is charged trainer_reassignment_fee_usd
